name: Trevor
title: trevor.io
shortDescription: Trevor.io is a versatile data analysis tool designed for teams across various industries. It allows users to connect directly to databases, create and share dashboards, and automate workflows. An example use case is a marketing team using Trevor to track campaign performance in real-time and automate reports.
pros: 5-minute setup with no credit card required
Supports real-time data streaming and alerts
cons: May require technical knowledge to set up and use
Limited customization options for advanced users
